note: Bureau of Reclamation primitive camping area on Confederate Bay, eastern shore of Canyon Ferry Lake (SR-284). North side of the bay is beach camping large enough for big rigs (narrow roads, tight turns); south side sites suit smaller RVs. --Claude
summary: Reclamation-run (Canyon Ferry Field Office) primitive area with dispersed camping; trailers/motor homes permitted per Reclamation's table. Confirmed vault toilets, no potable water, 14-day limit; added season open in winter (year_round). Fees left at the derived free (the table's fee column says 'N/A' but dates from 2020). reservable/fcfs left as recorded (not stated in those words). Dropped the note's 'temporarily calling it Campground 2' line: Reclamation's camping table names it 'Confederate Campground' and the 2020 renaming was reversed (KTVH).
